events.title: Play The Seaworks: Trap Season Next Fest Demo!
events.summary: You can now play the new demo of Seaworks: Trap Season as part of Steam Next Fest!What can you expect?The fax machine spits out another bounty. The weather is turning. Your boat needs work. And somewhere out there, beneath the cold northern water, your traps are waiting. Seaworks: Trap Season is a hands-on crab fishing life sim set on the remote pacific northwest in the 1990s.
